name: Pearl Polymers Limited
about: Pearl Polymers Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of PET bottles, jars, and containers to consumers and industries in India. The company provides storage jars and water bottles; kitchen essentials comprising school boxes, lunch boxes, fridge organisers, food storage containers, and chopping boards; and gift sets and clik and seal containers. The company sells its products under the Pearlpet brand name. Pearl Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is based in New Delhi, India.
